candidates.tier_reason: Eclipse-timing (light-travel-time) inference from one O-C curve. Pulley et al. 2025 report new 2022-2025 timings that none of the recent RR Cae models fit, and note a Lanza-type magnetic mechanism is energetically possible for exactly this second modulation. ETV planets around post-common-envelope binaries have a poor record.
